stories.headline: Hurricane Lala: Hawaii battles strong winds and rain as storm threat looms
stories.description: If the storm makes landfall, it will be Hawaii's first direct hit by a hurricane in 34 years.

stories.headline: People who fled Stourbridge fires start to return home
stories.description: Many families are only just discovering the extent of damage to their homes for the first time.

stories.headline: New satellite images show Europe’s disappearing rivers due to drought
stories.description: Half of Europe’s land is experiencing drought with rivers running low from the Danube to the Rhine.

stories.headline: How a simple lighter has become the backbone of life in Gaza
stories.description: In Gaza the struggle to find lighters can mean the difference between cooking a meal or going to bed hungry.

stories.headline: A nation divided: What do Israelis want in October’s elections?
stories.description: Despite a genocide and multiple wars, analysts say the issues determining October’s elections fall far closer to home.
